PAGE_NOT_FOUND_DESCRIPTION: This address isn't part of Arclayer Admin. Use the navigation to return to Overview.
UNEXPECTED_DESCRIPTION: This page did not finish loading. Refresh and try again. If it keeps happening, share this page address with your Platform administrator.
PLATFORM_SETUP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: Platform setup status could not be checked
PLATFORM_SETUP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE_RECOVER: Check the service connection and try again. Arclayer Admin won't assume setup is complete.
PLATFORM_SETUP_FAILED: The Instance Owner could not be created
PLATFORM_SETUP_FAILED_RECOVERY: Review the account details and try again. No successful setup was recorded.
INSTANCE_ALREADY_INITIALIZED_RECOVERY: Continue to Platform sign-in with the existing Instance Owner account.
INSTANCE_SETUP_REPAIR_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Ask the deployment administrator to repair the setup records, then check setup again.
EMAIL_EXISTS: This email is already in use
EMAIL_EXISTS_RECOVERY: Use a different email address for the first Instance Owner.
USERNAME_EXISTS: This username is already in use
USERNAME_EXISTS_RECOVERY: Choose a different username for the first Instance Owner.
PLATFORM_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email, username, or password is incorrect
PLATFORM_INVALID_CREDENTIALS_RECOVERY: Check your email or username and password, then try again.
PLATFORM_ACCESS_REQUIRED: This account does not have administrator access
PLATFORM_ACCESS_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Use an authorized administrator account or ask the Instance Owner for access.
PLATFORM_IDENTITY_CHANGED_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again to use the account's current status.
PLATFORM_AUTH_FLOW_INVALID: This sign-in has expired or was already used
PLATFORM_AUTH_FLOW_INVALID_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again and complete security verification.
PLATFORM_NETWORK_ERROR: Arclayer Admin could not reach the service
PLATFORM_NETWORK_ERROR_RECOVERY: Check your connection and try again. Sign-in wasn't completed.
PLATFORM_SESSION_EXPIRED_RECOVERY: Sign in and complete security verification again.
PLATFORM_SESSION_REVOKED: This device was signed out of Arclayer Admin
PLATFORM_SESSION_REVOKED_RECOVERY: Sign in again. If your administrator access was removed, ask the Instance Owner for help.
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED: A security key or passkey is required
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Add or recover a security key or passkey before continuing.
SECURITY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE_RECOVERY: This required security check can't be completed right now. Contact the deployment administrator; access wasn't granted.
SECURITY_KEY_CANCELLED_RECOVERY: Keep this page open and try the security key or passkey again.
PLATFORM_CODE_INVALID_RECOVERY: Enter the current code from your authenticator app and try again.
PLATFORM_AUTH_UNEXPECTED_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again. This attempt wasn't completed.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_TRIAGE_REVISION_CONFL: Another operator changed this item's work status first. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_SOURCE_RESOLVED: The responsible service confirmed this issue is resolved. Work status is now read-only.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another operator already claimed this item. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED: Assign this item before marking work in progress.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ASSIGNEE_INELIGIBLE: The selected operator is no longer available for assignment. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_REMINDER_INVALID: Choose a future reminder time and provide a reason. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists or you can't view it.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_REQUEST_FAILED: This request couldn't be completed. Nothing was changed.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The service returned a result that couldn't be used. Nothing was changed.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_INELIGIBLE: This workspace isn't eligible for this capability.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_NOT_AVAILAB: This capability isn't currently available for this workspace.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_NOT_SELECTE: This workspace hasn't been selected for this capability rollout.
